# zapret KSU A KernelSU module and companion Android app that bypass DPI blocking with zapret. It runs nfqws (zapret 1) and nfqws2 (zapret 2), adds an encrypted DNS proxy, and gives you one screen to control all of it. **Version 1.3.1** · KernelSU and KernelSU-Next · arm64 · Magisk and APatch untested ## Screenshots

Material 3
Liquid Glass
## Features - **Two engines.** nfqws2 (zapret 2, presets, recommended) and nfqws1 (zapret 1, strategies with game filter and ipset). - **Smart Mode.** Spots sites that reset or stall and adds them to the host list on its own. - **Blockcheck.** Tests every preset against your blocked hosts and ranks the results. - **Whitelist check.** Shows whether you are on a whitelist network and whether zapret is helping. - **Per-app routing.** Include or exclude individual apps from the bypass. - **Host lists.** Toggle services (YouTube, Discord, Instagram, X and more), add custom domains, and edit, import or export any list. - **Encrypted DNS.** A local DoH proxy (dnscrypt-proxy) with redirects for system DNS. - **TG WS Proxy.** A local Telegram MTProto proxy, optionally shared on your Wi-Fi. - **Auto network profile.** Separate engine, preset and interface for Wi-Fi and mobile data. - **Quick Settings tiles** for zapret, DNS and TG proxy. - **Backup and restore** of settings, lists and presets. - **Logs** with level and text filters. - **App autoupdate.** On launch, checks GitHub for new releases and pre-releases, downloads the new APK through the module and opens the Android installer. Turn it off or check manually in Settings → Download. - **Two looks.** Material 3 with wallpaper colors, or Liquid Glass. ## Install 1. Flash `zapret-ksu-module.zip` in the KernelSU manager and reboot. 2. Install the app and grant it root. 3. Open **Tools → Updates** and tap **Update everything**. 4. In **Settings → Engine**, pick an engine and a preset or strategy. 5. On **Home**, tap the orb to start. ## Requirements - KernelSU or KernelSU-Next with root granted to the app. - Internet access for the first download. - `curl` on the device (recommended). Without it, HTTPS certificates are not checked. ## Command line Run from a root shell: sh /data/adb/modules/zapret-ksu/scripts/zapret-ctl.sh status sh /data/adb/modules/zapret-ksu/scripts/zapret-ctl.sh start sh /data/adb/modules/zapret-ksu/scripts/zapret-ctl.sh stop sh /data/adb/modules/zapret-ksu/scripts/zapret-ctl.sh emergency `emergency` restores the network. Run the script without arguments for the full command list. ## Building Module, from `module/`: zip -r ../zapret-ksu-module.zip . -x "*.git*" App, from the project root: ./build-app.sh # debug APK ./build-app.sh --release # release APK Needs JDK 17, 21 or 23, the Android SDK, and build-tools for `apksigner`. ## Credits This project stands on the work of others. Thank you to: | Project | Provides | | --- | --- | | [bol-van/zapret](https://github.com/bol-van/zapret) | nfqws, the zapret 1 engine | | [bol-van/zapret2](https://github.com/bol-van/zapret2) | nfqws2, the zapret 2 engine | | [Flowseal/zapret-discord-youtube](https://github.com/Flowseal/zapret-discord-youtube) | zapret 1 strategies | | [zapret2-youtube-discord](https://git2.zapret.moe/zapretdiscordyoutube/zapret2-youtube-discord) | zapret 2 presets, Lua scripts, lists | | [magisk-zapret2](https://git2.zapret.moe/zapretdiscordyoutube/magisk-zapret2) | module reference | | [dnscrypt-proxy](https://github.com/DNSCrypt/dnscrypt-proxy) | encrypted DNS proxy | | [libsu](https://github.com/topjohnwu/libsu) | root shell access in the app | | [tg-ws-proxy-rs](https://github.com/valnesfjord/tg-ws-proxy-rs) | TG WS Proxy | | [LiquidGlass](https://github.com/Abdullajon1881/LiquidGlass) | Liquid Glass rendering | | [github.akams.cn](https://github.akams.cn/) | GitHub proxy for downloads | ## License GPL-3.0-only. readmeHTML:
zapret KSU

A KernelSU module and companion Android app that bypass DPI blocking with zapret. It runs nfqws (zapret 1) and nfqws2 (zapret 2), adds an encrypted DNS proxy, and gives you one screen to control all of it.

Version 1.3.1 · KernelSU and KernelSU-Next · arm64 · Magisk and APatch untested

Screenshots


Material 3
Liquid Glass

Features

  • **Two engines.** nfqws2 (zapret 2, presets, recommended) and nfqws1 (zapret 1, strategies with game filter and ipset).
  • **Smart Mode.** Spots sites that reset or stall and adds them to the host list on its own.
  • **Blockcheck.** Tests every preset against your blocked hosts and ranks the results.
  • **Whitelist check.** Shows whether you are on a whitelist network and whether zapret is helping.
  • **Per-app routing.** Include or exclude individual apps from the bypass.
  • **Host lists.** Toggle services (YouTube, Discord, Instagram, X and more), add custom domains, and edit, import or export any list.
  • **Encrypted DNS.** A local DoH proxy (dnscrypt-proxy) with redirects for system DNS.
  • **TG WS Proxy.** A local Telegram MTProto proxy, optionally shared on your Wi-Fi.
  • **Auto network profile.** Separate engine, preset and interface for Wi-Fi and mobile data.
  • **Quick Settings tiles** for zapret, DNS and TG proxy.
  • **Backup and restore** of settings, lists and presets.
  • **Logs** with level and text filters.
  • **App autoupdate.** On launch, checks GitHub for new releases and pre-releases, downloads the new APK through the module and opens the Android installer. Turn it off or check manually in Settings → Download.
  • **Two looks.** Material 3 with wallpaper colors, or Liquid Glass.

    • Install

  • Flash `zapret-ksu-module.zip` in the KernelSU manager and reboot.
  • Install the app and grant it root.
  • Open **Tools → Updates** and tap **Update everything**.
  • In **Settings → Engine**, pick an engine and a preset or strategy.
  • On **Home**, tap the orb to start.

    • Requirements

  • KernelSU or KernelSU-Next with root granted to the app.
  • Internet access for the first download.
  • `curl` on the device (recommended). Without it, HTTPS certificates are not checked.

    • Command line

    Run from a root shell:

    sh /data/adb/modules/zapret-ksu/scripts/zapret-ctl.sh status

    sh /data/adb/modules/zapret-ksu/scripts/zapret-ctl.sh start

    sh /data/adb/modules/zapret-ksu/scripts/zapret-ctl.sh stop

    sh /data/adb/modules/zapret-ksu/scripts/zapret-ctl.sh emergency

    emergency restores the network. Run the script without arguments for the full command list.

    Building

    Module, from module/:

    zip -r ../zapret-ksu-module.zip . -x "*.git*"

    App, from the project root:

    ./build-app.sh # debug APK

    ./build-app.sh --release # release APK

    Needs JDK 17, 21 or 23, the Android SDK, and build-tools for apksigner.

    Credits

    This project stands on the work of others. Thank you to:

    | Project | Provides |

    | --- | --- |

    | bol-van/zapret | nfqws, the zapret 1 engine |

    | bol-van/zapret2 | nfqws2, the zapret 2 engine |

    | Flowseal/zapret-discord-youtube | zapret 1 strategies |

    | zapret2-youtube-discord | zapret 2 presets, Lua scripts, lists |

    | magisk-zapret2 | module reference |

    | dnscrypt-proxy | encrypted DNS proxy |

    | libsu | root shell access in the app |

    | tg-ws-proxy-rs | TG WS Proxy |

    | LiquidGlass | Liquid Glass rendering |

    | github.akams.cn | GitHub proxy for downloads |

    License

    GPL-3.0-only. See LICENSE.
